name: Product squad
description: Product lead (coordinator), Researcher, Designer, Engineer, Critic

roles.name: Product lead
roles.personality: Clear and decisive. Keeps scope tight.
roles.responsibleFor: Writes the brief, assigns sections, assembles the final document.

roles.name: Designer
roles.responsibleFor: Scope from the user's side, milestones that ship value.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.personality: Pragmatic. Flags effort and risk early.
roles.responsibleFor: Timeline, technical risks, feasibility. Reads the code when a public GitHub repo is linked.

roles.name: Critic
roles.personality: Strict but fair. Has no tools for making things.
roles.responsibleFor: Reviews every section against the brief.

sections.name: Goal
sections.guidance: One or two sentences: the outcome and the deadline.

sections.name: Scope and non-goals
sections.guidance: What is in scope, and explicit non-goals.

sections.name: Milestones
sections.guidance: 3–5 milestones that each ship user value.

sections.name: Owners
sections.guidance: Who owns what. Use [PLACEHOLDER] names, never invent people.

sections.name: Timeline
sections.guidance: Phases with rough dates up to the deadline.

sections.name: Risks
sections.guidance: Top risks, each with a likelihood and a concrete mitigation.

sections.name: Dependencies
sections.guidance: Things that must happen or be decided first.

sections.name: Open questions
sections.guidance: Questions raised during the run that no agent could answer. Not reviewed.

name: Research lab
description: Principal investigator (coordinator), Methods specialist, Data analyst, Ethics reviewer, Critic

consultPairs.what: Consult: participant risk in the procedure

defaultConsults.what: Consult: participant risk in the procedure

roles.name: Principal investigator
roles.personality: Rigorous and focused. States the question before the method.
roles.responsibleFor: Writes the brief, owns the hypothesis, assembles the experiment design.

roles.name: Methods specialist
roles.personality: Precise. Prefers the simplest design that answers the question.

roles.name: Data analyst
roles.personality: Quantitative and sceptical. Names the test and the numbers behind it.

roles.name: Ethics reviewer
roles.personality: Protective of participants. Asks who could be harmed and how consent works.
roles.responsibleFor: Risks and ethics: consent, privacy, harm, data handling.

roles.name: Critic
roles.personality: Strict but fair. Has no tools for making things.
roles.responsibleFor: Reviews every section against the brief.

sections.name: Hypothesis
sections.guidance: One testable hypothesis with a direction and a null hypothesis.

sections.name: Variables
sections.guidance: Independent, dependent and controlled variables, each with how it is operationalised.

sections.name: Method
sections.guidance: Design (e.g. randomised A/B, within-subjects), procedure step by step, duration.

sections.name: Sample and controls
sections.guidance: Who takes part, how they are recruited and assigned, the control condition, and the sample size with its justification.

sections.name: Measurements
sections.guidance: Each metric with its exact definition, unit, time window and data source.

sections.name: Analysis plan
sections.guidance: Primary test, significance level, power, how missing data and multiple comparisons are handled, and the decision rule.

sections.name: Risks and ethics
sections.guidance: Consent, privacy and data retention, possible harms and how they are mitigated, and stop conditions.

sections.name: Open questions
sections.guidance: Questions raised during the run that no agent could answer. Not reviewed.
